# Sammamish Dispatch

> The Sammamish Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Sammamish, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Sammamish](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Sammamish news](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Beaver Lake](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/beaver-lake/): The plateau's east side around Beaver Lake Park and the Beaver Lake Preserve trails, out toward Soaring Eagle Park.
- [East Lake Sammamish](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/east-lake-sammamish/): The shoreline below the plateau along East Lake Sammamish Parkway, with Sammamish Landing and the East Lake Sammamish Trail.
- [Inglewood](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/inglewood/): The northwest plateau along NE Inglewood Hill Road and 228th Avenue NE, with the Inglewood shops and views west over Lake Sammamish.
- [Klahanie](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/klahanie/): The southeast plateau around Klahanie Park, Klahanie Village and Issaquah-Fall City Road, part of the city since 2016.
- [Pine Lake](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/pine-lake/): The middle of the plateau: Pine Lake Park's dock and lawn, Pine Lake Village and 228th Avenue SE.
- [Sahalee](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/sahalee/): The north end of the plateau along Sahalee Way NE, climbing from the Redmond line through the evergreens.
- [Town Center](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/town-center/): Sammamish Commons, City Hall, the library and the community and aquatic center along 228th Avenue and SE 4th Street, with the Town Center plan taking shape.
- [Trossachs](https://www.sammamishdispatch.com/trossachs/): The southeast corner off SE Duthie Hill Road and Trossachs Boulevard, next to Duthie Hill Park's trails.
